The vendor directly providing **Files.fm** at **files.fm** is **SIA "Files.fm"**.

### Evidence
According to the official *Terms of use of the Failiem.lv / Files.fm platform* on files.fm:
> *"Service provider: SIA “Files.fm”, registration No. 40003962231, VAT payer No. LV40003962231, Stabu Street 119, Riga, LV-1009, Latvia."*
> 
> *"These terms apply to the Failiem.lv and Files.fm websites, accounts, mobile and desktop applications, APIs, sharing tools..."*
